sections.text:
Lower
the base assembly (pedestals, fan housings, inlet boxes, and/or base frame) over the anchor bolts and set on the shims.

Add
shims so that all rocking motion is eliminated.

Level assembly in the axial
and radial direction by replacing or adding shims to bring the base assembly
level.

Apply
appropriate shim packs as necessary to obtain the proper elevation

Shim
and level the bearing support assemblies on their foundations. The bearing pedestals and sole plate, Surfaces must be level within 0.010
inches per foot [0.833 mm per meter].

After
tightening all anchor bolts, check each shim pack to assure equal loading.
NOTE: By using the thickest shims possible, all shim packs should have 
the least number of shims, Ideally,
there should not be more than five (5) shims in each pack.

Clean
the bearing and shaft seal machined surfaces of the rotor.

Add
the inlet cones over shaft ends and tie the cones to the wheel with straps or
cables (not chains).

Inlet cones should be
inserted as far as possible into the wheel. These cones are temporarily
strapped so that Shaft
and wheel assembly can be lifted into the housing as a
single assembly.

Install the rotor shaft with the inlet
cone(s), IVC(s) , and shaft bearing assemblies into
the lower fan housing. Snug
the bearing bolts but do not torque.
Install the remainder of the fan housing and the inlet box(es). Be sure to remove any temporary bracing.

Install
the remaining inlet cone bolts, while maintaining the concentricity of the
inlet cone

Set
and align the main motor for final running position. Be sure to check for
magnetic center.

Alignment of the motor must be set with
the motor shaft at its magnetic center
